annotations.title: Get an In Depth maamar or concept card

description: One Chassidut In Depth maamar (book + maamar slug, from list_in_depth): its parts and its concept cards. With a concept key, that card: what the term means, what it does in this maamar, and the deeper point, as an excerpt with a link that opens the card on the page.

concept.description: Optional: a concept key, e.g. tzimtzum.

language.description: he or en (other languages get English). Default en.
